evidence_bundle.query: condenser vacuum degradation air removal fouling feedwater oscillation cabinet HVAC

results.snippet: Operators observed degrading condenser vacuum coincident with abnormal air removal train A differential pressure and rising turbine backpressure.
Inspection history indicates condenser waterbox fouling trending upward over the last two operating cycles.
Cabinet AC12 cooling effectiveness degraded intermittently; elevated local cabinet temperatures may affect instrument reliability.
Procedure guidance for condenser vacuum degradation includes verifying air removal performance, condenser cleanliness, and instrument validity before load reduction.
